meta.notes: M1 and M2 are both capable of handling the toolkit and cable reel, but M1 can carry more. D1 can only carry up to 2 kg, so it's best suited for T1. M2 is used for T2 and T5 as it can carry the battery pack and spare pump. M1 handles T3 and T4 due to its larger payload capacity and endurance.
